description: This file defines a template class 'BinaryInterface' within the 'WebSockets' namespace, providing an interface for sending messages and setting message handlers over WebSocket connections. It includes external dependencies on websocketpp and logging utilities, and declares symbols for external use.

classes.name: BinaryInterface
classes.description: A template class providing an interface for WebSocket binary message communication, including methods to send messages and set message handlers.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message through the derived class implementation.

methods.name: setOnMessageHandler
methods.description: Sets a callback function to handle incoming messages.
